standard.summary: 选择 LoRA 的实现模块。networks.lora 是标准线性 LoRA；networks.lora_fa 是 Frozen-A 变体；lora_flux / lora_sd3 是针对特定架构的专用实现。
standard.effect: 不同模块决定 LoRA 如何注入目标层、是否支持特殊变体（DoRA、LyCORIS 等）。
standard.whenToUse: 大多数情况使用默认值即可，训练器会根据模型类型自动选择合适的模块。
standard.avoidWhen: 手动修改模块路径需要了解内部实现，错误的模块路径会导致训练失败。

optionDescriptions.networks.tlora: lulynx 渐进秩 LoRA（历史 T-LoRA key）。
optionDescriptions.networks.tlora_flux: FLUX 上的 lulynx 渐进秩 LoRA（历史 T-LoRA key）。
optionDescriptions.networks.lulynx_frozen_a_lora: LoRA-FA 模块的本地命名,后端归一到 networks.lora_fa。
optionDescriptions.networks.lulynx_progressive_rank_lora: 渐进秩 LoRA 模块,后端归一到 networks.tlora。

standard_en.summary: Chooses the LoRA implementation module. networks.lora is the standard linear LoRA; networks.lora_fa is the Frozen-A variant; lora_flux / lora_sd3 are dedicated implementations for particular architectures.
standard_en.effect: The module decides how the LoRA is injected into the target layers and whether special variants (DoRA, LyCORIS and so on) are supported.
standard_en.whenToUse: The default is fine in most cases -- the trainer picks a suitable module automatically from the model type.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Editing the module path by hand takes an understanding of the internals; a wrong path makes training fail.

optionDescriptions.networks.tlora: The lulynx progressive-rank LoRA (the historical T-LoRA key).
optionDescriptions.networks.tlora_flux: The lulynx progressive-rank LoRA on FLUX (the historical T-LoRA key).
optionDescriptions.networks.lulynx_frozen_a_lora: The local name for the LoRA-FA module; the backend normalises it to networks.lora_fa.
optionDescriptions.networks.lulynx_progressive_rank_lora: The progressive-rank LoRA module; the backend normalises it to networks.tlora.

advanced.principle: 模块以类路径形式指定（如 networks.lora），训练器通过 importlib 动态加载并初始化 LoRA 结构。
advanced.tradeoffs: 自定义模块允许接入第三方 LoRA 实现，但需要与训练器接口兼容。

advanced_en.principle: Modules are specified as class paths (e.g. networks.lora); the trainer loads them dynamically via importlib and initializes the LoRA structure.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Custom modules allow third-party LoRA implementations, but they must be compatible with the trainer's interface.
